messages:
Avery: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Dropping a short follow-up thread with links and owners. Put any missed items here.

Sam: Great session. Two quick asks: who will own Dedicated GA customer comms, and what's the SLA timeline?

Priya: Roadmap update: Dedicated GA target still Q3, SLA beta planned for Q4. I'm checking with Legal on proposed contract wording and will share notes.

Marco: I uploaded the initial Dedicated rollout playbook (internal link below). Canary checklist coming later today.

Leah: Sales needs a 1-page FAQ/one-pager for prospects. Can someone take this?

Priya: @Leah I can draft the FAQ one-pager by EOD Thursday. Will cover eligibility, pricing model, and expected lead times.

Jordan: UX ask: can we include console screenshots in the FAQ? I can put together quick mocks tomorrow morning.

Marco: I'll add screenshots to the playbook after the canary checklist is live.

Kai: Ops question from the huddle: what latency SLOs are we committing to for Dedicated? We discussed targets but need concrete numbers for docs.

Sam: Tentative targets: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 200ms on standard batch configs. Mark as 'target' until SLA beta is formalized.

Avery: Action items (react with :white_check_mark: when complete):
- Priya: Draft Dedicated one-pager for Sales (due Thu EOD)
- Marco: Publish canary checklist + console screenshots to playbook (due Fri noon)
- Jordan: UX mocks for FAQ (due Thu morning)
- Kai + Eng Infra: Formalize SLO numbers and add to docs (due Mon)
- Taylor: Send internal all-hands follow-up email with links (due Wed)

Taylor: I'll send the follow-up email Wed morning and include the FAQ and playbook links.

Leah: Thanks : will queue the FAQ into sales enablement once Priya shares it.

Priya: Pricing note: initial Dedicated deals will be negotiated with Sales; Finance supports a tiered reserved model. I'll add Finance to the doc.

Avery: Shared assets: slides https://redwood.ai/slides/all-hands-2026, recording https://redwood.ai/recordings/ah-2026. Ping me if access issues.

ops-bot: Deploy: canary-playbook.md updated by Marco at 2765432130.

Marco: Uploaded the checklist and a short how-to snippet:
```
# how to run a canary
redwood rollout --env dedicated-canary --model v1.2 --traffic 5%
```

Kai: We'll need a concise oncall runbook for Dedicated node degradation; adding a task to eng-sre board.

Sam: Quick market capture note: priority customer segments for initial Dedicated outreach: larger SaaS platforms (>50k MAUs), finance, healthcare. Priya/Leah to refine.

Avery: If other Q&A items surface, post them here. I'll consolidate and update the central action tracker. Appreciate the fast turnarounds! :sparkles:
